newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: HOCKEY-BECHMANN DOUBLE STRIKE SINKS ENGLAND.
newsitem.headline: HOCKEY-BECHMANN DOUBLE STRIKE SINKS ENGLAND.

text.p: Two goals by OLympic forward Christoph Bechmann fired Germany to a 2-0 win over England in their opening match at the Golden Jubilee of Pakistan hockey tournament on Monday.
The Germans struck first after an England corner, Bjorn Michel forcing his way deep into the circle for Bechmann to help the ball over the line in the 14th minute.
England improved after the interval but failed to profit from a few chances and seven penalty corners.
Germany had only four corners and scored their second goal from one of them, the ball being worked to Bechmann.
Paul Lissek, the German coach, said he was pleased with the performance of his team of old and new players and grateful to England for "squandering their chances".
Jon Royce, the England coach, said: "We were guilty of club shooting rather than international shooting".
